Subject: EOD gate clearance + ownership cleanse

Team —

Quick EOD ask to lock the forecast window and make sure account ownership + stage flags are accurate for tomorrow's submission. Small checklist below — please mark done in the ACME row of the shared sheet and attach the evidence file to your reply. I attached a working draft (ACME_commit_evidence.xlsx) and the current stage flags export (stage_flags.csv).

Checklist (EOD, today):
- Confirm "Commit" vs "Commit (pending PO)" on any ACME opportunities — mark who updated.
- Ensure Account Owner field matches SFDC (owner, sales contact, and AM).
- Upload a one-line evidence item per account (PO stub, signed SOW, or legal confirmation).
- Flag any deals needing RevOps manual override and ping @karthik_iyer.

Call: 17:00 PT standup if any unresolved items — quick 10 min to finalize.

Important: we cannot move ACME to Commit without either PO or explicit procurement confirmation. If procurement confirms intent but no stub, mark as "Commit (pending PO)" and note expected delivery time.

Thanks —
Hannah
